issues.summary: Methods names Python 3 with scripts deposited; Code availability releases only a Node.js extraction script and states no other software was used, so the scoring and weight arithmetic is not re-runnable.
The ocean-account route taxonomy generating the 12.79% and 13.70% headline shares is never defined, enumerated or closed in Methods.

Legends call the shares indicative rather than exact whilst Methods 3.5 and Section 5.5 call the weights printed and the statements exact; the distinction between printed inputs and rounded products is nowhere stated.
The MMAF 2022 reports and BPS decks carrying Figure 5, every maturity tag and every pilot-scale claim are cited but not redeposited and are unobtainable to a reader.
The statistical quality-assurance audit is named as the adjacent class of work with no work in that class cited anywhere, so the novelty claim still does not survive the reference list.
REGRESSION: the 16.99%/18.36% same-page source conflict now appears in the main text first in the Discussion, having been demoted out of Section 4.2 on 2026-08-20.
Earlier assessments are refuted without being named, though the correction is a headline contribution and the authors' own superseded mapping is such an assessment.
The claim that a province raises its score by producing more asserts a loading sign that Section 5.5 records as unrecoverable from the published record.
The 12.00 ha, 18.26 ha and 6.26 ha coral-loss figures carry no folio at the point of claim and no mark of whether they are printed or this study's subtraction.
'The register would be refuted by...' uses 'register' for the conditions-precedent finding, whilst the term denotes the 44-indicator register throughout 4.2 and 4.3.
Section 5.1 opens 'the load is now quantified and it is small' with no forward pointer to the Section 5.5 retraction of exactly that reading.
The low-variance and unstable-weight inference asserts estimator behaviour from aggregation formulae Section 5.5 records as illegible and reconstructed in notation only.
'A quantity BAPPENAS holds and has not released' asserts an agency's private holdings, where Limitations claims only absence from the public record, and no agency was engaged.
The nominal-versus-effective caveat still sits immediately before the widening close and blunts the build from result to significance.
The closing sentence restates the study's internal contribution rather than widening to the class of statutory composites built from published sectoral statistics.
REGRESSION: Section 2's close no longer states what Section 2 established, pivoting straight to Section 4's corrected percentage after the 2026-08-20 cut.
REGRESSION: after the renormalisation arithmetic was demoted to S2, Section 3.5 asserts its normalised-contributions warrant with the fifteen groups unnamed and the tolerance unquantified.
REGRESSION: with the 47 inline flags stripped, the three evidential distinctions have no locatable marker, and the contested-denominator distinction has dropped out of the three.
The corpus stopping rule is terminal on a single unproductive page, and neither the slice definition nor the per-slice page ranges appear in the article.
Data availability names no archive, persistent identifier, licence or version. Author-blocked: requires a repository account and a licensing decision. Tracked as ibei-ku6.
En-dash in prose, 'coupled human-ocean system', against the binding house-style prohibition.
Nine em-dashes or en-dashes remain in the back matter, which carries the figure legends and availability statements; Sections 1-6 were swept and it was not.
REGRESSION: supplementary pointers demoted on 2026-08-20 are inconsistent in granularity, S4.1 against Supplementary S4 and Supplementary S5 where the series sits at S5.4.
Anthropomorphised account: 'The account can tell a provincial planner which reef complex is driving a change'.
No paragraph break in 5.5 before 'What does not survive is the reading of 7.64%', so the retraction runs into the preceding argument.
Self-appraisal inside Results, 'this article's strongest internal counter-instance', which also pre-empts Section 5.2.
Evaluative framing inside Results, 'One item in the register is cheap', withdrawn by a conditional in the next clause.
'and is in the tier for a different reason' precedes the first Results use of the label Tier A.
Three naming variants for the standard across the manuscript: the spelled-out SEEA Ecosystem Accounting framework, SEEA Ecosystem Accounting in keywords, and SEEA-EA.
Eight entries are cited only by short form, so the in-text key does not match the entry's sort key. All resolve; none is an orphan; a copy-editing matter.
The antecedent of 'Both assume continued external technical assistance' is separated from the two follow-on studies by a long intervening sentence.
The sub-national feasibility claim rests on a single self-citation, Gacutan et al. 2022, which the text does not note as the authors' own.
'On its own registration' is opaque on first reading for a non-specialist, though it is doing real work.
Class of literature not engaged: SEEA-EA compilation feeding official indicator reporting outside Indonesia. Reviewer exemplars are unverified, verify before use.
'Moves three totals by 0.01' does not name which three, so the stated dual-route reproducibility cannot be checked from the main text.
